test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On: 2 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A seller gives 4 toys free of cost on buying 14 toys. What percent does the customer get as a discount?
solution:
Formula Used:

Discount% = (Discount/cost price) × 100

Calculation:

Let the marked price of 1 article = 100

⇒ MP of 4 articles = 100 × 4 = 400

Actual amount paid if discount is not given = MP of 18 articles = 1800

⇒ Discount % = (400/1800) × 100 = 22(2)/(9)\% 

∴ The correct answer is 22(2)/(9)\% 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**4 toys are free out of (14 + 4) = 18 toys

Discount % = 4/18 = 2/9 = 22(2)/(9)\%
